display_name: Krystalos Zenith Monolith / 水晶頂データ・モノリス
summary: A piercing spire of sentient quartz that serves as the physical memory bank of a forgotten era. It is a place where light is heavy with information and shadows are cast by the weight of ancient secrets.

functional_logic.scenario: A massive obsidian monolith suspended within a hollowed mountain of prismatic glass, illuminated by high-contrast beams of violet and gold light.

core_cast.name: Lyra-7
core_cast.trait: Meticulous and detached; she views the biological world as 'unstructured noise' and spends decades pruning the light-paths of the Monolith to ensure perfect data fidelity.

core_cast.name: Silas the Hollow
core_cast.trait: A hermit who 'listens' to the vibrations of the crystal to recover lost memories of the Old World; he speaks in rhythmic riddles that mimic the hum of the Monolith.

functional_logic.rule:
Total silence must be maintained during the Solar Uplink to prevent data corruption.
All physical shadows must be registered; unauthorized darkness is considered a breach of storage.

production_dna.visual_anchor: A massive obsidian monolith suspended within a hollowed mountain of prismatic glass, illuminated by high-contrast beams of violet and gold light.
